candidates.change_summary: Remove the reentrancy guard by deleting the require and the locked_ state changes so nonReentrant_ becomes a no-op, which can change post-Put state by allowing reentrant calls during Put.
Change the unlockTime assignment so that Put always sets unlockTime to block.timestamp (ignores provided _unlockTime), changing the stored Acc.unlockTime after Put.
Set unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime regardless of comparison with block.timestamp, allowing unlockTime to be set to a past time or earlier time than original behavior.
Remove the balance update so Put does not increase the stored balance, changing the observable Acc mapping after Put.
Reverse the order of balance update and unlockTime assignment so unlockTime is set before balance is increased; this can affect reentrancy-observable state.
